questions.question_description: Write a C program to build an expression tree from a postfix expression using a stack. Each operator becomes an internal node and each operand becomes a leaf node.
questions.input_format: A single line containing the expression string.
questions.output_format: Expected standard spacing based on the problem. See constraints.
questions.constraints: Expression length <= 100. Operands are single characters/digits.
questions.hints: Leverage standard tree traversal logic recursively.
questions.solution_explanation: Expression trees natively encode operator precedence into their structural branches.
